How It Works

1

Start with a Blank Canvas or Template

Choose from a library of diagram templates — flowcharts, UML, wireframes, mind maps — or begin with a blank canvas.

2

Drag, Connect & Style

Add shapes and connectors with drag-and-drop. Style with themes, colours, and typography that match your brand.

3

Share, Export & Embed

Share a live link, export as an image or PDF, or embed your diagram directly into Notion, Confluence, or your docs.
